newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares active, index gains.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares active, index gains.

text.p: Estonian stock market business stayed active on Friday, with the Tallinn Pharmaceutical factory and Savings Bank in the spotlight, dealers said.
Official list turnover came to 10.7 million kroons and the Tallinn stock exchange index rose 0.54 percent to 97.38 kroons.
The free market had 7.9 million kroons activity and Tallinn Pharmaceutical was the most active for the third day on business of 5.6 million kroons. It ended at 47 kroons versus 48.75.
"Pharma is keeping foreign investors interested. The drug business all over the world is a stable sector and it is also in Estonia," said Hansapank trader Mart Meerits.
Tallinn Pharmaceutical yesterday had 10 percent of its shares placed with Scandinavian and London investors and saw big volumes as the shares were bought by broker Williams de Broe.
On the official list, Savings Bank was most traded at 5.5 million kroons and it closed slightly lower at 36.55 kroons.
Dealers said the shares gained when during the day it forecast profits in 1996 of 70 million kroons.
It later fell after an announcement on its shareholders meeting on Monday. It said shares bought today would not give the right to receive new shares in a planned issue of stock.
Market leader Hansapank traded three million kroons of stock and it climbed to 96.80 kroons from 96.15 kroons.
